## OEM / ODM Service & 6-Step Process

**Source URL**: https://shenhezhongke.com/oem-odm.html

Skip to main content



 



 



 

 

 

 OEM / ODM

 
# OEM vs ODM — Which fits your brand?


 Both paths lead to your shelf. Here's how to choose.


 


 




 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
| Dimension | OEM | ODM |

 

 

 

 

 

 

 
| Formula | Customer provides formula / specs | Factory provides ready formulas |

 

 

 

 

 
| Best for | Brands with R&D / in-house lab | Startups, new entrants, fast launch |

 

 

 

 

 
| Lead time | 30–45 days (formula + sample) | 25–40 days (after the sample is approved) |

 

 

 

 

 
| MOQ | Negotiable per SKU | Negotiable per SKU |

 

 

 

 

 
| IP | Customer owns formula | Factory owns formula |

 

 

 

 

 
| Cost | Higher setup, lower unit | Lower setup, mid-range unit |

 

 

 

 

 
| Customization | Full formula customization | Label / packaging customization |

 

 

 

 

 
| Samples | Chargeable samples, 7–14 days | Chargeable samples, 5–7 days |

 

 

 

 

 
| Compliance | Customer-led | Factory-led (FDA, ISO, MSDS) |

 

 


 


 

 Still not sure which path fits? Talk to our solutions team.


 Start Your Quote

 


 


 




 

 

 

 

 
## Three ways to work with us


 


 

 

 

 

 


 
### Custom formulation (OEM)


 Your formula or your target claim. Eight in-house chemists develop and test the formula. Our joint laboratories with South China University of Technology and Guangdong University of Technology handle advanced formulation work. A custom formula plus a lab sample takes 30–45 days.


 For mature brands

 


 

 

 

 


 
### Private label


 Our formula, your brand. Artwork, carton and label are yours. The formulation, the specification and the reports stay ours. Private-label lead time is 25–40 days after the sample is approved.


 For fast launch

 


 

 

 

 


 
### Full service (OBM)


 Formula, packaging and compliance handled end to end under one owner. The scope and the schedule are quoted against the brief.


 For new entrants

 


 


 


 




 

 

 

 

 Process

 
## 6-step process from enquiry to shipment


 A clear, documented process — every step has a deliverable and an owner.


 


 

 
#### Enquiry
Brief, target market, MOQ and timeline



 
#### Sample
Chargeable sample, fee confirmed in the quotation, 5–7 days for an existing SKU



 
#### Quote
A quote with a named contact, within one business day



 
#### Contract
NDA, formula agreement, payment terms



 
#### Production
Batch production with on-site QC sampling



 
#### Shipment
FOB Guangzhou, full export docs

 Factory tour

 
# A 30,000m² industrial park built to OEM/ODM standards — not a contract kitchen


 5,000m² GMP workshop, class-D cleanroom filling lines, on-site QC lab, and 1,000,000 bottles of monthly capacity. Walk the park, audit the process, and ship from the dock you visited.


 

 Book a Factory Visit

 View Park Photo

 


 


 




 

 

 

 

 

 

 


 




 

 

 

 

 The facility

 
## Three connected blocks, one integrated supply chain


 


 

 

 


 
### 30,000 m² industrial park


 Self-owned land in Heyuan, Guangdong — no third-party lease risk. Park includes production, warehouse, dormitory, and wastewater treatment on a single secured site.


 3 buildings·Self-owned land


 


 

 


 
### 5,000 m² GMP workshop


 ISO 22716 GMP-aligned with class-D cleanroom filling, purified water system, and a dedicated chlorine-dioxide suite. Photographed during your audit visit.


 Class-D cleanroom·ISO 22716


 


 

 


 
### 3,000 m² office building


 Houses sales, customer service, regulatory, finance, and the R&D documentation team. English-speaking account managers work from this building.


 220+ staff·EN support


 


 


 


 




 

 

 

 

 Production lines

 
## Six integrated lines from raw material to packed carton


 Each line is built to handle the volumes that brand clients actually order — not lab-scale curiosities. Lead times are documented, not promised.


 


 

 

 


 

 01


 
#### Purified water system


 RO + EDI dual-stage, on-site generation. Continuous conductivity monitoring. Foundation for all aqueous formulas.


 


 


 

 


 

 02


 
#### Stainless mixing & blending


 500L–2,000L jacketed vessels with temperature, RPM, and vacuum control. Batch records captured digitally for every formula.


 


 


 

 


 

 03


 
#### Class-D cleanroom filling


 Peristaltic and piston fillers for 30 mL–1.5L formats. Class-D environment with online particle counting and personnel gowning protocol.


 


 


 

 


 

 04


 
#### Capping, sealing & induction


 Screw cap, pump, sprayer, and tamper-evident induction seal. Inline torque testing and leak detection at full line speed.


 


 


 

 


 

 05


 
#### Labeling & coding


 Auto-label applicators, batch coding, lot and expiry printing. Your artwork, your languages, your barcodes.


 


 


 

 


 

 06


 
#### Carton & pallet packing


 Shrink-wrap, inner box, master carton, and ISPM-15 export pallet. Ready for direct FOB Guangzhou/Shenzhen 


 


 


 


 All six lines are documented in our video audit pack — request it from your account manager.

 Storage & logistics

 
## From the workshop to the shipping container — under our roof


 Finished goods move from the GMP workshop into a temperature-controlled warehouse within the same park. No third-party logistics partner, no handoff between buildings, no inventory that leaves our sight until it reaches your nominated forwarder.


 

 
- ✓ Raw material warehouse — quarantined IQC area, segregated by batch and supplier.


 
- ✓ Finished goods warehouse — climate-monitored, FIFO-racked, lot-traceable from any pallet.


 
- ✓ Export dock — direct 


 
- ✓ 1,000,000 bottles / month — current capacity headroom, confirmed against the production schedule on each order.

## R&D, Quality Control & Documentation

**Source URL**: https://shenhezhongke.com/capabilities.html

Skip to main content



 



 



 

 

 

 R&D & Quality

 
# University-partnered R&D, on-site QC lab, and a 6-step process that ships only what we can defend


 Every claim on this site is backed by a registered IP, a documented process, and a third-party lab report. Our technical team develops every formula — and we let you audit every step of how it gets to your customer.


 

 Download Audit Pack

 View All Reports

 


 


 




 

 

 

 

 

 Technical team

 
## In-house R&D, backed by university partnerships


 Our in-house technical team is responsible for every formula on this site — from the bio-enzyme + probiotic deodorizing complex to the stabilized chlorine dioxide disinfectant system. We don't white-label third-party formulas and we don't pass through generic bases.


 In addition to our internal team, we maintain active R&D cooperation with partner universities in formulation chemistry, microbiology, and packaging engineering. This gives us access to academic literature, validation methods, and a pipeline of graduate-level researchers for the custom formula projects that go beyond the catalogue.


 

 In-house technical team

 University R&D partnerships

 Microbiology lab

 Formulation chemistry

 Custom formula development

 


 


 

 

 

 

 


 


 


 


 




 

 

 

 

 Lab capabilities

 
## What we measure in-house, before we ship


 Our on-site lab handles routine QC. For final claim verification (kill rates, allergen removal, probiotic counts) we use independent third-party labs — reports published in full.


 


 

 

 

 

 


 
#### pH & conductivity


 Every batch. Calibrated daily. Recorded in the batch ledger.


 


 

 

 

 


 
#### Microbial limits


 Total plate count, yeast & mold, E. coli, S. aureus, P. aeruginosa — per pharmacopeia.


 


 

 

 

 


 
#### Active content


 Chlorine dioxide concentration, enzyme activity, probiotic CFU counts.


 


 

 

 

 


 
#### Stability & aging


 Accelerated aging at 40°C / 75% RH. Long-term shelf-life validation for new SKUs.


 


 


 


 




 

 

 

 

 6-step QC process

 
## From incoming raw material to packed carton


 Every batch is traceable end-to-end. If a claim ever needs defending, we can produce the full documentation chain in under an hour.


 


 

 

 1


 
### IQC · Incoming Quality Control


 Every raw material lot is sampled on arrival. COA from supplier is verified against in-house re-test for identity, purity, and microbial load. Non-conforming lots are rejected and isolated.


 REJECT-RATE TRACKED

 


 

 2


 
### Formula batching


 Mixing & blending under validated process parameters: temperature, RPM, vacuum, hold time. Batch records captured digitally and counter-signed by the line supervisor.


 DIGITAL BATCH RECORD

 


 

 3


 
### IPQC · In-Process Quality Control


 pH, viscosity, active content, and visual checks at pre-defined checkpoints. Out-of-spec batches are quarantined before filling — not after.


 CHECKPOINT-LEVEL

 


 

 4


 
### Filling & packaging


 Class-D cleanroom filling with online particle counting. Fill-weight verification, torque testing on caps, leak detection, and visual inspection on every unit.


 UNIT-LEVEL TRACE

 


 

 5


 
### OQC · Outgoing Quality Control


 Final sampling per AQL. Microbial limits, active content, appearance, pH, and packaging integrity. Only lots that pass every OQC check are released to the warehouse.


 AQL SAMPLING

 


 

 6


 
### 3rd-party claim verification


 For every claim published on this site (94.2% ammonia removal, 99.999% kill rate, etc.) we commission an independent lab. Reports are public and PDF-downloadable.


 INDEPENDENT LAB

 


 


 


 




 

 

 

 

 Documentation

 
## Every claim has a paper trail. Every paper trail is downloadable.


 Regulatory, import, and retail compliance all depend on consistent documentation. We provide the full set with every shipment and on-demand for prospect clients.


 


 

 

 
#### MSDS


 Material Safety Data Sheet for every SKU. Bilingual EN/Chinese where required.


 Per SKU·Updated 2024


 


 

 
#### COA


 Certificate of Analysis for every production batch, with lot number and test results.


 Per batch·Shipment-attached


 


 

 
#### Third-party lab report


 Independent accredited-lab verification (CMA / CNAS) of every claim on the product page.


 Per claim·Public PDF


 


 

 
#### FDA registration


 Facility registration confirmation and product listing details for the US market.


 Facility-level·On request


 


 

 
#### ISO 22716 GMP certificate


 Cosmetic GMP scope certificate from our certification body. Audit report available under NDA.


 Facility-level·2024 renewal


 


 

 
#### Customs & export documents


 Commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, and HS codes prepared for every shipment.


 Per shipment·Standardized


 


 


 For the full document set under NDA, contact your account manager →


 


 




 

 

 

 

 

 Custom development

 
## Your formula, our lab — under NDA, on a documented timeline


 For OEM projects, our R&D team starts from your spec — target performance, ingredient preferences, regulatory targets, and target cost. We sign a mutual NDA before any formula or spec exchange.


 Typical OEM project: 30–45 days from spec acceptance to lab sample, then another 15–25 days for pilot batch and stability. Your formula, your IP — we sign an IP assignment at project kickoff.


 

 
- ✓ NDA signed before any spec exchange


 
- ✓ IP assignment at project kickoff — formula belongs to you


 
- ✓ Stability data provided before commercial order


 
- ✓ Compliance hand-off for FDA, EU, and target-market filings


 


 OEM / ODM Models

 


 

 
### Custom project timeline


 

 
- 

 1

 Spec & NDA · 2–3 days
Mutual NDA signed, performance spec locked.


 


 
- 

 2

 Lab formulation · 10–15 days
3–5 candidate formulas, internal performance screen.


 


 
- 

 3

 Sample & approval · 5–7 days
Lab samples shipped, your team's feedback.


 


 
- 

 4

 Pilot batch & stability · 15–25 days
Pilot run, accelerated stability, COA.


 


 
- 

 5

 Commercial run · 15–45 days
First production batch to your nominated forwarder.
